description: This file defines a TransactionsProvider class in Dart, used within a Flutter application to manage bank transactions. It wraps a TransactionsRepository to load, add, and filter transactions, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: TransactionsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of bank transactions, providing methods to reload transactions, filter by account, and add debit or credit transactions.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes a TransactionsProvider by creating a repository and loading data asynchronously.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads transactions from the repository and notifies listeners.

methods.name: addDebit
methods.description: Creates and adds a debit transaction, then reloads data.

methods.name: addCredit
methods.description: Creates and adds a credit transaction, then reloads data.
